layers_note: `layers` is every layer the machine executes. With `independent_support_layer_height` on (the stock profile) support adds layers of its own, so it exceeds `object_layers` (max_z / layer height).
filament_mm3_source: length x wire cross-section, both from the slicer's G-code header
support_note: summed over the G-code's `; FEATURE: Support*` blocks (the slicer states no support total); the same sum reproduces its own filament total to 0.0000 %. Density 1.270 g/cm3 from the slicer preset. This is extruded 1.75 mm wire, not the part-space volume `printcheck.json` reports.
